name: recall
description: Project memory with a verdict on every search. Searches your project's own notes and decisions, marks a retracted claim as superseded, and refuses when nothing clears the threshold.

serving_dsn.title: Database DSN
serving_dsn.description: The store RE-call reads. For a local store with no database server, run `recall setup --lite` and paste the sqlite:/// address it prints. For PostgreSQL, run `recall quickstart` or `recall setup` first; both print the DSN when they finish. Looks like postgresql://recall:recall@127.0.0.1:5497/recall

table.title: Table
table.description: Legacy PostgreSQL chunk table. Use `quickstart_chunks` for `recall quickstart` and `chunks` for standard setup. Lite, generation mode, and authenticated tenant routing require the default `chunks` setting and refuse other values at startup.

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: Which corpus in that database to search. `recall quickstart` writes to the `quickstart` tenant; `recall setup` writes to `default`.

trust_mode.title: Trust mode
trust_mode.description: `strict` refuses to answer from a corpus whose threshold was never fitted to it, which is the right default for anything real. Use `development` to search an uncalibrated corpus, including the one `recall quickstart` builds.
